full_name: Arthur Ou | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Arts William and Flora Hewlett Foundation Fellow The New School
bio: Arthur Ou is a Taiwanese-American artist, educator, and writer and a 2024 Guggenheim Fellow in photography. During his time at Radcliffe, he will complete work on a book project including visual and textual material on a reconsideration of photographic history through the natural sciences, engaging in fields such as anthropology, biology, and cosmology.
